The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 37e6d650c989c3fb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let (X, B + M) be a projective generalized log canonical Q-pair. Thus X is normal and integral, B is an effective rational boundary, and M is the trace of a nef rational Cartier divisor on a higher projective birational model, with KX + B + M Q-Cartier. There are a normal integral projective variety Y and a birational map ϕ: X --→ Y whose inverse contracts no divisors such that, writing BY = ϕ∗B and taking MY to be the trace of the same nef b-divisor, the generalized pair (Y, BY + MY ) is log canonical and AX,B+M (E) ≤ AY,BY +MY (E) for every prime divisor E over their common function field. The inequality is strict for every divisor on X contracted by ϕ. More precisely, the following alternatives are determined by D = KX +B+M: (i) if D is pseudo-effective, then KY + BY + MY is nef; (ii) if D is not pseudo-effective, there is a projective contraction h: Y → T to a normal projective variety with connected fibres such that dim T < dim Y, ρ(Y/T) = 1, −(KY + BY + MY ) is ample over T.
